t: LAP GU10 LED light bulbs deliver energy-efficient illumination suitable for various indoor lighting installations. This five-pack provides reliable warm white light at 2700K, creating a welcoming atmosphere in residential and commercial environments. Featuring a focused 36-degree narrow beam angle, these dimmable GU10 LED lamps are ideal for accent lighting in kitchens, living rooms, or retail displays where concentrated light is beneficial. With an impressive 25,000-hour lifespan and a low 3 kWh per 1000 hours energy consumption, these bulbs reduce maintenance and running costs while providing consistent light quality with an 80 Colour Rendering Index.
